title: Hydrate Upon Waking
description: Drink 1-2 glasses of warm or room-temperature water before your morning tea, coffee, or breakfast.

title: 10-Minute Morning Daylight
description: Step outside within the first hour of waking to anchor your circadian rhythm and boost morning alertness.

title: Screen-Free Wind-Down
description: Turn off televisions, laptops, and smartphones 45 minutes prior to your target bedtime.

title: 10-Minute Post-Meal Stroll
description: Take an easy, gentle walk after your largest meal to aid digestion and support healthy glucose regulation.

title: Mindful Chew & Savor
description: Eat at least one meal today without screens or multitasking, chewing food thoroughly and noticing flavors.

title: Midday Posture & Spine Reset
description: Stand up, roll shoulders, and perform 2 minutes of gentle chest opening and spinal twists.

title: Colorful Veggie Inclusion
description: Ensure at least half your lunch or dinner plate is filled with colorful cooked or fresh vegetables.

title: 4-7-8 Evening Relaxation Breaths
description: Perform 4 rounds of slow diaphragmatic breathing to switch on your body natural relaxation response.
